description: This file contains a utility class 'AverageAnglesUtil' used for processing log files related to engine RPM and analog chart data, specifically for trigger discovery in the rusEfi project.

classes.name: AverageAnglesUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to parse a CSV log file, extract RPM and analog chart data, and generate a report.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for the utility. Validates arguments and initiates log processing.

methods.name: runUtil
methods.description: Processes the log file, extracts relevant data, and returns a report string.
